newsitem.title: FRANCE: Aero Cargo Int'l opens office in Toulouse.
newsitem.headline: Aero Cargo Int'l opens office in Toulouse.

text.p: French cargo sales agent, Aero Cargo International, said it had opened an office at Toulouse-Blagnac airport earlier this month.

"Our major airline customer in Toulouse is Corsair which operates Boeing 747 passenger services from the airport to La Reunion (Indian Ocean) and the French West Indies. The majority of these flights originate in Paris, making a stopover in Toulouse to pick up passengers and freight," an Aero Cargo official told Reuters.
Aero Cargo also has offices at Paris/CDG, Paris/Orly, Lille, Lyon Nantes, Marseille,Nantes, Strasbourg.
The GSA's airline customers also include Aeromexico, Asiana, Austrian Airlines, British Midland, Cubana and Kenya Airways.
